profile.reading: Per QTS own site, DC4 is part of the QTS Richmond 1 campus, located at 3560 Portugee Rd, Sandston, VA 23150. The Richmond 1 campus totals 207 acres, 2.3 million sq ft of current space, and 238 MW of power capacity across six DC buildings (DC1-DC6); no per-building MW figure is published.
profile.capacity_note: Part of QTS Richmond 1, a 207 acre campus totaling 2.3 million sq ft of current space and 238 MW of power capacity across six DC buildings (per operators own site); the 238 MW / 2.3M sqft figures are campus totals, not this individual building.
profile.research_note: Facility specific seeding pass 2026-09-02, batch 16 (mega-operator no-sources-key gap, QTS Richmond 1 phase 2 buildings): matched to Richmond 1 campus via operators own site, distinguishing from the adjacent Richmond 3 campus on the same road. research_status remains complete.
sources_tried: attempted qtsdatacenters.com (redirected to an unrelated domain, q.com, so not used as a source) and qts.com (unrelated Quality Transportation Services company; not QTS Data Centers)
profile.regional_context: QTS was founded in 2003 by Chad Williams, went public via IPO in 2013, and was acquired by Blackstone (via Blackstone Infrastructure Partners and BREIT) for approximately $10 billion, completed August 31, 2021, at $78/share. QTS is headquartered in Overland Park, Kansas.
profile.facility_type_note: Part of QTS's Richmond, Virginia mega-campus, spanning Henrico County and Sandston. This is QTS's flagship facility story: in 2010 QTS converted a former semiconductor manufacturing site into what Wikipedia describes as a 1.3 million square foot mega data center.
